scientific_integrity: The commutator and all-order theorem have an analytical proof. Rational computer checks verify specified identities and witness factors; finite numerical examples do not establish the theorem. Historical precedence remains subject to independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic scalar well-mixed reduced payoff-feedback model; finitely switched regimes with A_i>0 and fixed exposures; terminal cooperation only; stationary baseline basin witness; no general stochastic or spatial conclusion.
title: An exposure-budget ordering law for payoff-feedback evolutionary games
